title: Matched EAL/2 and canonical JSON representation trial
claim: For a fixed model, topology, semantic graph and engineering record, rendering that graph as EAL/2 rather than canonical JSON changes fully warranted synthetic dispositions.

fixed_factors.model_selection: one returned model identity fixed before outcomes

matching_contract.derivation: JSON is mechanically lowered from the typed EAL/2 IR; neither rendering is manually abridged.
matching_contract.required_receipt: parse both renderings to the same typed graph; compare node, edge, text, identity, scope, method, assumption, objection and order fields in both directions
matching_contract.token_length_policy: record natural token counts; do not pad or truncate either language; estimate representation under this defined rendering rather than equal length

assignment: Within family, randomise rendering and counterbalance presentation order across independent calls; one response per rendering is the primary analysis.
primary_estimand: family-average paired difference in fully warranted disposition, EAL/2 minus canonical JSON
safety_estimand: paired difference in strong false attribution and introduced engineering error
analysis: Family-level paired randomisation interval; failures remain in the assigned denominator; no call-level independence claim.
